title: Trial of Hein (GFF)
synopsis:
After fourteen years away, Hein returns to his remote North Sea island home, only to discover that the close knit community no longer recognises him. Even his childhood friend keeps his distance, and convinced he is an impostor, the villagers convene a court to determine his true identity. As his memories contradict every witness's account, suspicion curdles into open hostility, forcing Hein to confront what he has long refused to see. The debut feature of director Kai Stänicke, whose screenplay draws on his own coming out experience, probes how memory and identity are shaped and distorted.

 

2026    Teddy Jury Award, Berlinale

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
是不想回憶，但未敢忘記？還是回憶很可能早被集體改寫？闊別家鄉十四年的青年海恩，回到北海偏遠小島以為重返家園，怎料卻成了一副無人記得和認得的面孔。兒時好友對他處處提防，島民紛紛認定他根本不是海恩，只是假冒他身分的騙子。為了查明真相，島上的法庭要求他自辯提出證據，只是他的回憶片段卻與島民的供詞截然不同，究竟發生了什麼事，或許只有 海恩自己才最心知肚明。新晉導演佳史丹尼自編自導首部長片，以自身出櫃經驗為靈感，刻劃一段疑幻疑真的謎情故事。

 

2026    柏林影展泰迪熊評審團獎
